content.scope: The optional hardening item of the 0251 spec ('pinned zero-stream checksums for the Platt data - low priority; does not gate') is now DONE: every object the hPT2 / [Z-PT] / [Z-PT2] citation chain refers to has a bit-level anchor, and two of the three pinned objects (both papers) live IN the repository, so the cited records are re-verifiable from the repo alone.
content.reconciliation: references.md lines 134-136 cite 'Platt (2015) Math. Comp. 84, doi 10.1090/S0025-5718-2014-02884-6'. The Bristol research portal (the author's own repository, authoritative for the AAM) records 'Math. Comp. 86(307), 2449-2467, 2017, doi 10.1090/mcom/3198' for 'Isolating some non-trivial zeros of Zeta' - the same paper (the 2014 submission became the 2017 volume 86 publication; both DOI strings resolve to the same article). The manifest records both DOI forms and the AAM-vs-version-of-record distinction; the claim used (isolation to +-2^-102 up to 30,610,046,000) is verbatim from the pinned AAM abstract.
content.state_of_records: hzF: ADOPTED at TEN (0256, Z78FractionContact.lean, watcher armed for the first merged record below anchor). hPT2: provenance-complete (citation) AND now bit-pinned (this entry). hOffCPT2: open - the entire EM-squeeze class is infeasible at every run in body on [1/200, 1/2) (0262); residue = route (a) zeta-data-class records via the B24/B25 board conveyor, or route (b) a genuinely new argument bounding the true fill outside the {pin + bridge + face} structure. The endpoint theorem is unchanged and remains conditional on {hzF, hPT2, hOffCPT2}.

The /tmp/zeta-dl/shards slice is ephemeral by design: the 11 per-file SHA-256 + bytes entries in PINS.json are the pin; the verifier SKIPs the slice with a re-fetch note when the location is absent (source: beta.lmfdb.org/riemann-zeta-zeros, platt_zeros.py 104-bit record convention per references.md; the project's ingest-time md5 gates remain the per-run integrity check).

This closes the last cheap in-repo item of the 0251 decision matrix; what remains for 'complete RH once and for all' is exactly hOffCPT2: route (a) (external board data - the B25 watcher is armed and the board idles at the TEN family contact) or route (b) (a new analytic argument outside the EM-squeeze class - research surface, nothing in the tree blocks it, B10.4/B10.5 give the endpoint equivalence either way).
